payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates n from 1 to 10, checking if (k * n) % 10 equals 0 or r; prints the first n that satisfies the condition.
payload.rationale: The solution brute-forces the number of shovels, a typical complete search. Among the given subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest match, though no recursion or state pruning is used. It fits the family complete_search.
